notes.title: The Hideaway Early Access release delayed
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone ![/h3]

I know that such an announcement is likely to disappoint many but we decided to delay the release of The Hideaway Early Access by two months,

As we received a lot of bad feedback from players and influencers we decided to delay the release of the game to correct some bugs that are left in the game, implement new environments and really optimize the ones that are currently implemented into the game,

Thanks for being part of the community and see you in two months !
